name: Dekuple S.A.
summary: ADLPartner SA is a company that delivers a range of marketing services both within France and globally. Its operations encompass the sale of magazine and newspaper subscriptions, alongside comprehensive cross-channel marketing strategies and insurance brokerage. Additionally, the firm offers expertise in consulting, technology, and marketing engineering, and specializes in developing robust customer relationship management. Established in 1972, ADLPartner SA is headquartered in Montreuil, France, and operates as a subsidiary of Sogespa SAS.
